Put your built .rom images in this folder (copyrighted; not included).

Each supported set has a .mra recipe here. Build one with the MAME romset
of the same name:

    mra spyhunt.mra        writes spyhunt.rom
    mra spyhuntp.mra       writes spyhuntp.rom

spyhuntp is a split clone set, so keep the parent spyhunt.zip alongside
spyhuntp.zip when building it.

Keep the .rom files in this folder on your Pocket SD card, then pick the
game from the core's menu.
